digest.component_or_area: attestation validity and plan-review pin enforcement
propositions: When enforce_plan_material_pins is true, stale, missing, or malformed pins must invalidate attestations; when false, the same conditions report as advisory without changing validity
Configuration read failures for enforce_plan_material_pins must fail open (return false) with structured warning, modeled on mcp_readonly()

compute_validity must be extended with a PlanValidityProfile parameter (DEFAULT, CLOSE, DRIFT_REFRESH) where CLOSE and DRIFT_REFRESH disable only code-freshness checks while retaining signature, registry, own-material, and pin validation

drift_refresh_candidate must delegate all validity checks including pins to compute_validity(DRIFT_REFRESH) before attempting dependency-hash comparison, and must return None for invalid or reopened attestations
resign_plan_review must validate reviewed_related_material pins from the sidecar without calling compute_validity, enforcing pin health rules when enabled and remaining advisory when disabled

_run_plan_review must persist the pre-LLM reviewed_related_material snapshot through sidecar.emit(reviewed_related_material=...) so that failed-sign recovery has a baseline without a certified attestation
